row.notes: First offers the signal to each handler in the pointer array node+0x30..+0x38 (vcall +0x78) and returns if one consumes it. Then compares the signal id at signal+8 with a table of global id hashes (0x146ca47b4.., 0x146ca4690, 0x146ca4394/98, 0x146ca4800..0x146ca4848, g_Vm_RaiseCommandPinHash) and dispatches: node vcalls +0xa0, +0xa8, +0x98(0/1), +0xc0 and +0xd0 (flag plus a bool read from the signal args, key 0x145a6a418), +0xc8, +0xd8, +0xe0 (skipped when byte node+9 bit 2 is set); sets or clears flag bits 0x20 at node+8 and 0x40 at node+9; posts messages through g_Vm_UiSystem vcall +0x68; resolves and links a registry node named by a string arg (Vm_Resolve_RegistryNode, Vm_Link_RegistryNode); forwards the command-pin signal to the object at node+0x20 (vcall +0x190). Callers are derived node handlers that call it first and then test their own signal ids: 0x1437fed50 (raises one of two node events 0x146104e2c/0x146104e30), Game_Fade_UINodeGraphFadeOutRequestNode, and 0x1438093f0 (looks up node factory 0x50483146). Good hook point to trace UI node signals. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
